high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from C.C. Gong (@CCgong) on Twitter. The tweet reads: "My boyfriend is in YC and this is what I come home to Friday night. I make sure that he’s fed, do his laundry cut his hair. I give feedback, customer intros, and encouragement. YC girlfriends should be granted sweat equity. @ycombinator 30 days until demo day 💪" The tweet is accompanied by a photo showing a cozy living room scene. In the photo, a person is lying on a beige couch, covered with a brown blanket, wearing light-colored pants
